note: Documentation only; validate.py is the checker.
roles: list of role keys; every bullet's role must be one of them

bullets.role: a key from roles; 'project' needs a project name
bullets.marks: {<version name>: {raw: text or null, in: true|false}} for every file in versions/
bullets.private_note: text, never scanned for private terms
bullets.tech: list of strings (missing = warning, except on a candidate)
bullets.status: optional: approved (default when absent) or candidate; a candidate is a draft that is checked but never marked in, placed in a version or used in a tailoring
